_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for weapon combat stats. Used by the dice page's attack roller (dice.html) AND by the store catalog (quartermaster-insert.html via weapons.js). 'id' matches the goods key in prices.json. Damage is dice notation (NdM). type: 'attack' = d20 to-hit, then damage (crit on natural 20 doubles the weapon dice); 'save' = area attack — the target makes a save, so you only roll damage. brutal:true adds one extra weapon die on a crit. feats[] are optional toggles: addDice adds dice once; setDmg/setSave override for that option. Edit here and both the dice page and the store update on next load.

weapons.name: Colt Army Revolver, .44
weapons.notes: Reload 6 · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Colt Navy / Pocket Pistol
weapons.notes: Light · Concealable · Reload 5 · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Derringer
weapons.notes: Light · Hidden · 1 shot · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Winchester '66 Repeater
weapons.notes: Two-handed · Repeating (fires every round) · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Sharps Hunting Rifle
weapons.notes: Two-handed · Reload 1 · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Surplus Army Musket
weapons.notes: Two-handed · Reload 1 · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Single-Barrel Shot-Gun
weapons.notes: Cone, not aimed — no armor helps. Point-Blank (within 5 ft): disadvantage on the save. Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Double-Barrel Shot-Gun
weapons.notes: One barrel: 2d6, DC 13. Reload 2 · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Bowie Knife
weapons.notes: Light · Finesse · Thrown. Never misfires, never runs dry.

weapons.name: Tomahawk
weapons.notes: Light · Thrown · Brutal (extra die on a crit) · Silent.

weapons.name: Throwing Spear
weapons.notes: Thrown · Versatile · Silent.

weapons.name: War Lance
weapons.notes: Reach · Brutal. Unwieldy on foot.

weapons.name: Hunting Bow
weapons.notes: Two-handed · Ammunition · Silent (no muzzle-flash, no report).

weapons.name: Miner's Pick
weapons.notes: Tool first, weapon when it must be. Advantage on checks to break rock.

weapons.name: Lariat (Lasso)
weapons.notes: On a hit the target is Restrained (escape DC 12 Str). No damage. From horseback, drag a roped target.

weapons.name: The Hesperus — Auto-Pick
weapons.notes: Two-handed · Heavy · Twice-Striking (one extra attack per Attack action) · Clockwork (Wind 3) · Misfire 1.

weapons.name: Coal-Oil Bomb (Molotov)
weapons.notes: Splash 5 ft (1d6). Burning — a failed save takes 1d6 fire each round until put out.

weapons.name: Stick of Dynamite
weapons.notes: 10-ft radius. 1-round fuse (a quick foe may throw it back). Burning on a fail.

weapons.name: Bundle (Three Sticks)
weapons.notes: 15-ft radius. Structural — drops walls, floors, bridges, trestles.

weapons.name: Blasting Powder Keg
weapons.notes: 20-ft radius. Cannot be thrown — set and lit. Leaves a 10-ft crater.
